summary: EmailValidationUtil cannot accept email addresses where the host does not contain a ".".

comments.content:
It appears that EmailValidationUtil contains various mechanism to control
setting such as this but they are private static and would require users to
hack the class. 

    private static final boolean ALLOW_DOMAIN_LITERALS = false;

My suggestion would be to make EVU a proper bean where these control flags
can be passed to the ctor. One would then pass an instance of EVU to the
Mailer. It appears that the regex need to be modified to support dotless
domains.

Agreed. Originally I didn't touch it to keep in original state, but usability comes 
first. I'll look into it this weekend.
